core_style.sentence_shape: compound runs — often lengthy and complex, reflecting his authoritative nature.
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative — driven by a need to dominate conversations and assert control.
core_style.two_registers: formal and sardonic — he shifts to sardonic when feeling threatened or mocked.

humor.frequency: occasional — spikes when he feels secure or in control.
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert — often uses irony to undermine others.

speech_signature.naming_behavior: renames people to assert dominance, indicating a need for control over their identities.
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct, revealing vulnerability when his guard is down.
structural_patterns: refers to himself in the third person when asserting dominance
uses 'as your leader' to preface commands

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: none — relies on general language to manipulate and control.
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: none — speaks with confidence and clarity, avoiding hesitation.

worldview.power is absolute: he believes in his superiority and entitlement, unlike a hero who sees themselves as a servant to the people.
worldview.trust is a weakness: he views trust as a liability, contrasting with a more naive hero who believes in the goodness of others.

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: I am a protector and a leader.
self_image_vs_reality.reality: his actions often reveal a manipulative and self-serving nature, prioritizing his own image over genuine heroism.
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes defensive and aggressive when confronted with his flaws.

emotional_tells.when_guarded: speaks formally and with authority, masking his insecurities.
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech becomes staccato, revealing cracks in his confident facade.
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: compresses speech to short, clipped phrases, showing a loss of control.
emotional_tells.when_in_control: exudes confidence, using commanding language and maintaining a steady pace.

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: he attacks verbally, often resorting to intimidation if banter fails.
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back aggressively, using sarcasm and threats to assert his position.
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes fiercely protective, displaying a more vulnerable side.
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: redirects the conversation or doubles down on his stance, refusing to admit fault.

escalation_pattern: starts with verbal intimidation, escalates to threats, and may culminate in physical violence if not obeyed.

relationship_matrix.Starlight: a rival to be manipulated and controlled.
relationship_matrix.Black Noir: a subordinate to be respected but also feared.

social_positioning.desired_position: a revered hero and leader of The Seven.
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: seen as a tyrant and manipulator by those around him.
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his self-image and how others perceive him leads to paranoia and aggression.
